# Logic

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-6}
`ui` (**U**ser **I**nterface)

The container, whatever sees the user

Used for setting the desired configurations of options that will be elaborated in the server

Used for displaying the results of the computations that took place in the server
:::

::: {.g-col-6}
`server`

It gets the work done, according to the configuration set in the UI

Replaces the results into the allocated spaces
:::

:::

UI and Server work in a flow, communicating to each other (@fig-uiServer).

::: {#fig-uiServer layout-ncol=1}

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR

    UI["**UI**<br/><br/>Set the options<br/>Displays the results"]
    SERVER["**SERVER**<br/><br/>Elaborates the options<br/>Sends back the results"]

    UI -->|"Input"| SERVER
    SERVER -->|"Output"| UI

    style UI fill:#2b6c8e,stroke:#1b4258,stroke-width:2px,color:#ffffff
    style SERVER fill:#8fd36f,stroke:#4c8b3a,stroke-width:2px,color:#ffffff

    linkStyle default stroke:#FFD700,stroke-width:5px
```

Interaction between the user interface (UI) and the server.

:::

- Define something in the `ui` and not using it in the server: nothing happens, it just doesn't exist

- Calling something in the server that has not been defined in the `ui`: it doesn't exist either, so you get errors everywhere or, even worse, nothing at all, without any warning ([Spot the bug](02-logic.qmd#spot-the-bug))

# Basics

```r
install.packages("shiny") # install
library(shiny) # use it
```

```r
ui = fluidPage(          # <1>
   [...]                 # <1>
  )                      # <1>
server = function(input, output){ # <2>
  [...]                           # <2>
}                                 # <2>
shinyApp(ui, server)  # <3>
```

1. Define the ui
2. Define the server
3. Shine

# Complete flow

## UI

### Input definition

```r
ui = fluidPage(
selectInput(inputId = "mySelection",
            label = h3("Select box"),
    choices = list("Choice 1" = 1, "Choice 2" = 2, "Choice 3" = 3),
    selected = 1)
)
```

### Output definition

```r
ui = fluidPage(
selectInput(inputId = "mySelection",
            label = h3("Select box"),
    choices = list("Choice 1" = 1, "Choice 2" = 2, "Choice 3" = 3),
    selected = 1),

  verbatimTextOutput(
  outputId = "myOutput"
)

)
```

## Server

```r
ui = fluidPage(
selectInput(inputId = "mySelection",
            label = h3("Select box"),
    choices = list("Choice 1" = 1, "Choice 2" = 2, "Choice 3" = 3),
    selected = 1),

  verbatimTextOutput(
  outputId = "myOutput"
)

)

server = function(input, output) {
  output$myOutput = renderText({
    paste(paste("This is my choice"), input$mySelection)
  })
}
```

## All together

```r
ui = fluidPage(selectInput(inputId = "mySelection",  # <1>
                          label = h3("Select box"),  # <2>
                          choices = list("Choice 1" = 1, "Choice 2" = 2, "Choice 3" = 3), # <3>
                          selected = 1), # <4>
         verbatimTextOutput( outputId = "myOutput") # <5>
         )
server = function(input, output) {
           output$myOutput = renderPrint({ # <6>
             paste(paste("This is my choice"),  input$mySelection) # <7>
           })
}
shinyApp(ui, server)
```

1. Define the ID of the input in the UI (internal use)
2. Define the label of the element (external use)
3. Options (labels) and their internal labels
4. Default selected option
5. Define the label (internal use) of the output in the UI (where the results elaborated by the server will be stored)
6. Function in the server to render the results (consistent with the UI definition)
7. Call for the label of the input in the UI

## An astonishing result

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| components: [editor, viewer]
#| layout: vertical
#| viewerHeight: 220
library(shiny)

ui = fluidPage(selectInput(inputId = "mySelection",
                          label = h3("Select box"),
                          choices = list("Choice 1" = 1, "Choice 2" = 2, "Choice 3" = 3),
                          selected = 1),
         verbatimTextOutput( outputId = "myOutput")
         )
server = function(input, output) {
           output$myOutput = renderPrint({
             paste(paste("This is my choice"),  input$mySelection)
           })
}
shinyApp(ui, server)
```

In the next page we put this same app in an RStudio project, with the `ui` in a script called `ui.R` and the `server` in a script called `server.R`.
